Command the Skies with the RC Flying Sword!

Experience a whole new way to fly with this sword-shaped stunt drone. Sleek, powerful, and easy to control—it's perfect for kids, teens, and adults who love aerial fun.

Easy to Fly for Everyone

Take off and land with one click!
Choose from three speed modes (Low/Medium/High) and enjoy smooth, stable control with the 2.4GHz interference-free system. Great for both beginners and experienced pilots.

Epic Aerial Stunts

Perform 360° flips and rolls with a single button!
The 4-axis design delivers powerful lift and precision control for awesome stunt action.

Durable & Safe Design

Made from EPP shock-resistant foam, the Flying Sword is lightweight yet tough.
Enclosed propellers keep fingers safe and extend the drone’s lifespan—even after rough landings.

Fly Anytime, Anywhere

Bright LED lights make night flying thrilling and easy to track.
Enjoy dazzling aerial shows both day and night.

Longer Flight, Less Waiting

Comes with a rechargeable lithium battery that’s easy to replace.
Swap in a fresh one and keep flying—no long downtime between flights!

Specifications

  • Product Name: RC Stunt Flying Sword Drone

  • Material: EPP Foam + Electronic Components

  • Control Frequency: 2.4GHz

  • Remote Distance: Approx. 20m

  • Charging Time: About 30 min

  • Battery: Rechargeable Lithium

  • Dimensions: 37.5 × 18 × 4 cm

  • Recommended Age: 14+
